verdict.rationale: Gecko Security is an AI vulnerability scanner, so custom secret-detection rules are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions secret scanning or user-defined detection rules. The GitLab token rotation and expiry alerts cover Gecko's own integration credentials, not detection of an organization's secret formats in code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can define custom detection rules for my organization's internal token and secret formats
